scripts._comment_compile_desc: Compiles Sass to CSS, then adds vendor prefixes. Production version also minifies and removes comments via cssnano.
scripts._comment_watch_desc: Watches Sass files for changes and recompiles. Note: Vendor prefixes are added only during 'compile:scss' for production builds.
scripts._comment_watch_11ty: Runs Eleventy dev server with live reload. Watches HTML templates and content.
scripts._comment_validate_desc: Validates all assets before build. Checks for corrupted files, missing FFmpeg, etc.
scripts._comment_test_desc: Runs all test suites. Use test:validator or test:shortcodes for specific tests.
scripts._comment_lint_desc: Checks JavaScript code quality. Use lint:fix to auto-fix issues.
scripts._comment_content_desc: Tools for creating and managing content. Use new:case-study to scaffold new projects.
scripts._comment_optimize_desc: Converts images to WebP and videos to WebM. Optimized during build. If FFmpeg is missing, videos are skipped with warnings.
scripts._comment_preprocess: == VIDEO PREPROCESSING (Run manually when videos change) ==
scripts._comment_preprocess_desc: Optimizes videos IN PLACE in _src/assets/ (creates .webm + .webp posters). Run when adding/updating videos, then commit the optimized files to Git.
scripts.prebuild: npm run compile:scss:production && npm run validate:assets
scripts._comment_prebuild: Runs automatically before 'build'. Validates assets and compiles/minifies CSS.
scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production npx @11ty/eleventy && npm run minify:js && npm run optimize:images && npm run optimize:videos
scripts._comment_build_desc: Full production build: 1) Minify CSS, 2) Generate & minify HTML, 3) Minify JS, 4) Optimize images/videos. Output: _site/
scripts._comment_serve_desc: Fast dev mode. Compiles CSS once, then runs watch:scss and watch:11ty in parallel. No optimization.
scripts._comment_serve_full: Dev mode with CSS compilation and live reload. Use 'build' for full asset optimization.
scripts._comment_serve_verbose: Dev mode with verbose logging for debugging Sass and Eleventy.
